    01 — The Director

    Twenty years
    behind a camera.
    Three inside
    the machine.

    I'm Nir Brainin — filmmaker and creative director, graduate of Bezalel Academy of Arts and Design. My father handed me a camera at fifteen and I never really put it down.

    Three years ago generative video arrived. Most people saw a toy. I saw a camera that could shoot anything — a desert station, a street in Genova, a world that doesn't exist yet.

    What I bring isn't prompting. It's twenty years of knowing where to put the camera — the framing, the cut, the pacing. Now nothing is out of reach.

    Every project is fully produced and edited, brief to final cut. One contact. No agency timeline.

    20+Years Filmmaking
    50+Films & Spots
    BZLBezalel Graduate
    What I actually do

    You bring the idea.
    I bring everything else.

    One person, the whole pipeline — concept, script, generation, edit, sound, colour, delivery. No production company, no agency timeline, no handoffs.

    The road here

    Twenty years,
    four chapters.

    Click a chapter.

    2007 — 2010 · Home Front Command

    Computer Operator

    Three years in the Central District as a computer operator. Systems, shifts, and a deadline that genuinely does not move. It taught me to stay calm when a plan falls apart at 3am — every production since has felt manageable by comparison.

    • Home Front Command
    • Central District
    • Systems
    2015 — 2023 · Nuvei, Tel Aviv

    In-House Video & Content

    Eight years inside a fast-moving fintech company producing live event coverage, corporate films and scripted marketing pieces. This is where I learned how brands actually think — what a marketing team needs, how a funnel works, and why a beautiful film that misses the brief is still a failed film.

    • Brand Storytelling
    • Live Events
    • Marketing
    2016 — 2020 · Bezalel, Jerusalem

    B.F.A. Photography

    Four years learning to actually see — composition, light, and the difference between a picture that's correct and one that's alive. I pushed toward video and film inside the photography programme, showed in group and solo exhibitions, and graduated with a surrealist experimental documentary on hallucination: real stories, performed by friends.

    • B.F.A.
    • Exhibitions
    • Experimental Doc
    2023 — Now · Independent

    AI Filmmaking

    Generative video arrived and I went all in. Three years of daily practice across every major model, on top of twenty years of shooting and cutting. Commercials, brand films, music videos and shorts — and finally a camera that can shoot anything I can picture.

    • Direction
    • Generative Video
    • Full Post
